indicator_name: Subsistence minimum (BNS, price-based), total, pensioners, children 0-13, by region, monthly, KZT
description: Величина прожиточного минимума (расчёт БНС по ценам), всего, пенсионеры, дети 0-13 лет, по регионам, помесячно, тенге
methodology: Taldau 704492, period 4: the BNS-computed subsistence minimum from current prices (seasonal, follows food prices) -- NOT the level fixed in the budget law for benefits (SOCIAL_STANDARDS VPM_LAW: 50 851 in 2026). Two dimension sets: 2011-01…2024-12 under region dictionary 67, 2025-01 on under dictionary 4843 (national node 77397431). National TOTAL 2024-12 50 293, 2025-01 51 548, 2026-09 73 563; Almaty city 2026-09 82 320. Children 0-13 from 2014-11 (older definition not carried).
